thesis: The speaker describes his early fascination with stock prices, financial numbers, and the behavioral aspects of markets, which led him to study how investor behavior changes stock prices beyond fundamentals. He explains that his academic thesis focused on identifying when fear or greed drives market movements, a concept he recognized as an early form of behavioral finance.
